title: agent_graph.py broken due to missing await
body:
Async function build_graph is not awaited when called recursively for the sub agents. This breaks the graph rendering in the web UI.

for sub_agent in agent.sub_agents:
    await build_graph(graph, sub_agent, highlight_pairs) # add missing await
    draw_edge(agent.name, sub_agent.name)

linked_prs.title: fix: Fix broken agent graphs
linked_prs.body:
fix: Fix broken agent graphs

Fixes #973, #1170

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
The issue concerns agent workflow execution—specifically, recursive orchestration of sub-agents in the agent graph. The missing await disrupts agent workflow, fitting the "Workflow issues" category in the agent issue taxonomy.
